name: telar
description: AI agents and workflows for Kotlin Multiplatform, as small typed graphs: loops, parallel steps, streaming, save points and human approval. Inspired by LangGraph.

paragraphs: AI agents and workflows for Kotlin, as small typed graphs. You write each step as a suspend function on a data class of your own, and connect the steps with arrows. Telar runs the graph on every Kotlin platform, from a server to Android, iOS and the browser, and takes care of loops, parallel steps, live streaming, save points, and pausing until a person approves.
Try it in your browser: Pixel Pizza is a small game in which every stage runs a Telar graph, from two nodes in a row to a full agent workflow. No account and no API key needed.
